tei:div.tei:p: "!# :bla sgrub thugs kyi yang snying bzhugs so:

shasagahatha: bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams la 'dud: de dag ma lus kun 'dus pa'i: bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pas: da lta bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon: las can rnams kyis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi: sbyor ba la yang chos bdun te: nges 'byung bsam pa brtan po yis: dben pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor bsham: sku gsung thugs rten mchod gtor bkram: dang po rgyud sbyong la yang gsum: tshogs zhing mdun gyi nam mkhar bsam: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed ni: sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bca' 'o: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags: gsang sngags bsgrubs la rjes yi rang: smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor: lhun gyis grub par bzhugs su gsol: snying po sems can don phyir bsngo: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: gnyis pa lam rnams kun gyi gzhi: tshad med bzhi po bsgom pa ni: sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig: sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog: bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing: chos kun mnyam nyid la gnas shog: gsum pa bar chad bgegs bskrad ni: hūm̐: rang rig lha yi dkyil 'khor du: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bdud dang bgegs: rang snang 'dod yon gtor ma longs: mtha' bral gnyis med klong du dengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: bzhi pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: mi 'gyur rdo rje sku gsung thugs: ye nas ye shes rtsal rdzogs pa'i: snod bcud gzhal yas lha dang sngags:

rdo rje'i gur khang me dpung 'bar: hūm̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: lnga pa brda sgo dbye phyag dang: bshags shing dam bca' sgom pa ni: ye nas snang srid gdod nas dag: dkyil 'khor chen por mthong phyag 'tshal: sngon nas ma rig sgrib pa bshags: da ni rang rig las mi 'da': na mo pra be sha ya shud+dhe a: sa ma ya hūm̐: drug pa snod bcud byin dbab ni: hūm̐ hrī: rang bzhin dbyings na bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: ye shes rang rtsal gzugs kyi skur bzhengs nas: byin chen dbab cing dbang chen bskur du gsol: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang gsal dus la bab: gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī dz+nyā na ā be sha ya ā: bdun pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: ye shes raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bag chags sbyangs: lhun grub bde chen bh+rūm̐ las bhañja'i snod: hūm̐ las ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsir 'khyil: āḥlas 'khor ba rang grol rak+ta'i mtsho: oṃ las dbyings ye zung 'jug gtor ma'i sprin: snang ba ma 'gag mchod rdzas ci yang 'char: oṃ ma hā a mṛta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā rak+ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: de ni sngon 'gro'i las rim bdun: sgrub pa kun gyi sngon 'gro 'o: sa ma ya: spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la: dang po bskyed rim bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: ye nas 'khor 'das ka nas dag: lhun grub 'od gsal bde ba che: so sor rtog pa'i yi ge hrī: rang rtsal 'od 'bar snod bcud sbyangs: dwangs ma kun 'dus 'byung ba lnga: ye shes lnga yi gzhal yas khang: dbyings ye gnyis med zhing khams gsal: dbus mtha' med pa'i klong dkyil na: 'gyur med rdo rje'i brag steng du: zung 'jug pad nyi 'bar ba'i dbus: hrīḥlas dbang chen rta mgrin dmar: rta gdong rab bzhad gri thod 'dzin: khro bo'i chas rdzogs 'dor stabs bzhengs: yum mchog rdo rje phag mo dmar: gri thod gar bsgyur brkyang bskum 'khril:

phag skad ngur zhing khro mo'i chas: bdud bzhi rab brdzis me klong gsal: spyi gtsug pad sdong nyi zla'i steng: rdo rje 'chang chen thod phreng rtsal: dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi 'dzum can: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod: g.yon pas mnyam gzhag ka pā la: bdud rtsi'i bcud mchog tshe bum bcas: gsang yum kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon du brten: gsang phod chos gos ber phyam dang: pad zhwa sgro dar me long dang: rin chen rgyan cha du ma gsol: skyil krung gzi brjid 'od 'bar ba: bde gshegs thams cad sku la rdzogs: ngo bo gcig las rang rtsal tshul: phyi rol rin chen zur brgyad la: zhi drag 'tsham pa'i khri steng du: shar du pad+ma 'byung gnas mthing: rdo rje dril 'dzin longs spyod rdzogs: lha lcam dkar mo gnyis med 'khril: shar lhor pad+ma saṃ bha dkar: chos gos gsum gsol paṇa zhu mnabs: skyabs sbyin thod pa bcud ldan bsnams: lho ru blo ldan mchog sred dkar: sngags 'chang cha lugs rin chen brgyan: ḍā ma ru dang pad phor bsnams: lho nub pad+ma rgyal po dmar: 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs can: ḍā ru dang ni me long bsnams: nub tu nyi ma 'od zer ser: rnal 'byor brtul zhugs spyod pa'i chas: nyi zer zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: nub byang shākya seng ge ser: mtshan bzang dpe byad sprul sku'i chas: sa gnon mnyam gzhag lhung bzed bsnams: byang du seng ge sgra sgrog mthing: khro bo'i cha lugs 'dor stabs bzhengs: rdo rje 'dzin cing sdigs mdzub mdzad: byang shar rdo rje gro lod smug: rab byung dang ni khro bo'i chas: rdo rje phur 'dril stag steng 'gying: sgo bzhir pad+ma nyi ma'i steng: dbang gi sprul pa dpa' bo bzhi: mkha' 'gro'i rnam rol dhā ki bzhi: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las: rigs kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan can: gri thod gar bsgyur 'khril sbyor bzhengs: gzhan yang steng 'og phyogs mtshams su: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro ma: chos srung nor lha sprin ltar gtibs:

'dod yon mchod sprin bsam mi khyab: rang snang rang gsal 'ja' tshon bzhin: snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom: gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐: gnyis pa dbang bskur byin rlabs ni: ye nas sgo gsum rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs: brda rtags gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'bar: dug lnga phung po gnas dag ye shes lnga: dbang rtags rgyal ba rigs lngas dbur brgyan gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: gsum pa ye shes 'gugs bstim ni: sbyang gzhi khams rgyud lhar dag pa: sbyangs 'bras ye shes der smin pa'i: gdengs ldan ma yengs rnam rtog kun: bsal phyir lha rnams thams cad kyi: thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: dpal ri pad+ma 'od la sogs: rang bzhin sku gsum zhing rnams nas: ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs bsam: hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃḥdza: zhes bzlas mtsho la char bab bzhin: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa gnyis med bstim: bzhi pa mchod bstod 'bul ba ni: rang nyid mchod pa'i lha mor sprul: dang po gdan 'bul phyag 'tshal ni: hūm̐ hrī: dam tshig ye shes lha tshogs rnams: gnyis su med par bzhugs su gsol: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la: rang rig ngang du phyag 'tshal lo: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: gnyis pa phyi nang gsang mchod ni: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos:

snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang: 'dod yon rnam lnga rgyal srid bdun: bkra shis rdzas rtags la sogs pa'i: phyi yi mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul: dbang lnga gsur chen zhun chen me: khrag mkhris sha khrag rkang gling dang: thod rnga rang byung nang mchod 'bul: dga' bzhi bde chen byang chub sems: chags bral gsang ba'i sbyor mchod 'bul: ma traṃ ru dra gnyis 'dzin bdud: gnyis med klong du bsgral mchod 'bul: dug lnga sel ba'i a mṛta: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman mchod 'bul: gnyis med gsang ba'i khrag chen po: chags bral rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul: lha dang mi yi zhal zas dang: sha lnga bdud rtsi bza' bca'i tshogs: gtsang rme blang dor kun spangs pa'i: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: mchod dang mchod yul blang dor kun: spros bral kho na nyid kyis mchod: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da pū dza ho: ma hā sarba pū dza ho: ma hā a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: gsum pa bstod pa ni: hrī: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sku: gsung ni mi 'gag mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung: thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das: sku gsung thugs ldan pad+ma rgyal la bstod: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med: bkra shis yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku: 'jig rten mnga' bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po'i sras: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rat+na thod phreng rtsal: dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: thams cad lhun grub bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: phrin las rdzogs pa'i rje la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: ma chags skyon gyis ma gos pa'i: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la bstod:

yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa'i: pad+ma saṃ bha'i sku la bstod: shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa'i: blo ldan mchog sred sku la bstod: khams gsum srid gsum dbang sdud pa'i: pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la bstod: rmongs pa'i mun sel 'gro ba 'dul: nyi ma 'od zer sku la bstod: log 'dren bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad pa: shākya seng ge'i sku la bstod: mu stegs dam sri tshar gcod pa'i: seng ge sgra sgrog sku la bstod: dregs pa dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i: rdo rje gro lod sku la bstod: hrī: rang byung bde chen snang ba'i sku: rta mgrin dbang gi sku la bstod: stong nyid shes rab mkha' dbyings mo: rdo rje phag mo'i sku la bstod: bde stong zung 'jug rtsal las sprul: mkha' 'gro ging gi tshogs la bstod: thams cad chos kyi dbyings su rol: chos srung tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: lnga pa 'dzab la bskul ba ni: hrī: snang srid gzhal yas bla ma lha: thams cad phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor che: dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom: de ltar bskul nas bsnyen pa la: spyi bo'i bla ma'i gnas bzhi nas: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang 'phros: rang gi gnas bzhir thim pa yis: sgrib dag dbang bzhi thob par bsam: gsol 'debs snying po sngags 'di bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: bye ba gcig bzlas nga dang mjal: drug pa sgrub pa'i man ngag la: spyi bo'i rigs 'dus bla ma rje: dgyes pa chen pos sku chung ngu: snying gi dbus su son pa las: snying ni bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dbus: pad sdong rab rgyas nyi zla'i steng: de nyid gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: rang nyid bla ma rdo rje 'chang: mthing gsal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i tshul: rdo rje dril 'dzin yum dang 'khyud: lha lcam dkar mo gri thod 'dzin: gnyis med bde sbyor skyil krung bzhugs: dbu skra thor tshugs cod pan can: dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan:

'od 'bar lham mer gsal ba la:1$0000250 rang byung 'dzab bzlas mchod cing bstod: 1$0000300bla ma'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba thams cad mchod: 'gro ba'i sgrib pa kun sbyangs nas: thams cad bla ma'i sa la bkod: bde gshegs rtsa gsum chos skyong gi: lha sngags phyag mtshan spyan drangs nas: thugs ka'i bla ma'i gnas su thim: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rab 'bar zhing: snang grags lha sngags dran rtog thugs: bla ma rang sems dbyer med pa: mos gus rtsal bskyed sngags 'di bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: sngags 'di bzlas pa tsam gyis ni: gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas bdag: gnas der skad cig nyid la 'ong: byin rlabs zil che rtags kyang 'byung: brag kha dag nas chu 'bab bzhin: ma yengs rtse gcig bzlas pa'i tshe: sha med 'od kyi gzugs dag ni: ye shes sku can char ltar nyil: rnal 'byor lus ngag sems la thim: nga dang gnyis su med par 'gyur: grangs ni 'bum phrag lnga tsam bzla: pad+ma 'byung gnas logs na med: rang gi sems nyid lhan cig skyes: sgrib gsum spangs pa 'di kho na: pad+ma 'byung gnas dngos yin pas: ma yengs mi bsgom gzer gyis thob: bltas pas re dogs lha mi mthong: ma bltas bzhag na rang sar grol: de tshe pad+ma'i rang zhal mjal: bla ma rang thim dbyer med 'dres: ro gcig chen por rtogs pa na: dngos grub gzhan nas btsal mi rnyed: de yis dngos grub mchog chen thob: bdun pa las la sbyar ba ni: spyi bor rigs 'dus bla ma gsal: rta mgrin yab yum thugs ka ru: nyi steng hrīḥm de bzhin du: dpa' bor ra tsa hri ya bzhi: mkha' 'gror ha ri ni sa gsal: gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: 'khor gyi sde bzhi yab yum bskul: so so'i sa bon thams cad las: 'od zer dkar ser dmar mthing 'phros: nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad zhi:

tshe bsod ye shes yon tan rgyas: mi dang mi min dbang du bsdus: dgra bgegs 'byung po brlag par bsam: de yang phyogs dus kha dog ni: zhi dus shar dkar nam langs dus: rngam brjid lho ser snga dro'i dus: chags sems nub dmar dgong mo'i dus: gtum drag byang mthing srod kyi dus: de dag la sogs rnams la sbyar: rig pas 'phrul zhing the tshom med: gang bsam las rnams 'di yis 'grub: rig pa'i rtsal bskyed sngags 'di bzla: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ dza: shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ ba shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: bzlas tshul so so'i rig pas 'phrul: de ltar bskyed rim las kyi gzhung: man ngag chos bdun dag tu rdzogs: spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi las: de la rnam pa bdun yin te: dang po tshogs kyi 'khor lo la: thog mar bshams shing byin rlabs ni: zhing ngam gcan gzan lpags pa'i khar: tshe gal zla rgyas zla phrom dang: māṃ sa shing thog khur ba bsham: bsang chu 'thor zhing: oṃ sarba dra byaṃ bi sho dha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin sbyang: bh+rūm̐ las bhañja'i snod du sha lnga dang: bdud rtsi rnam lnga khams dang phung po'i bcud: me rlung sbyor bas 'od zhu rnam par dag: rlangs pas 'khor 'das bcud bsdus 'bru lnga yi: rnam par dam tshig bdud rtsir rab 'dres pas: ye shes lnga yi 'dod yon mchod sprin spro: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐:

gnyis pa dang po mchod pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i ngang nyid las: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod sprin bsam mi khyab: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: dgyes par bzhes la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: gsum pa bar pa skong bshags ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la: rang snang rnam dag 'dod yon mchod sprin gyis: gnyis med klong du thugs dam gnyan po bskang: ma rig nyams chag thams cad mthol lo bshags: sa ma ya shud+dhe ā: bzhi pa tha ma bsgral mchod ni: hūm̐: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dgra bgegs rnams: dug gsum srid pa'i hom du bkug: ye shes rno dpal mtshon gyis bsgral: rnam thar gsum gyi zhal du bstab: nṛ tri mā ra ya phaṭa: māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: lnga pa tshogs la longs spyod ni: brda dang brda yi 'bul len gyis: tshe ni tshe dang gal ni mchog: māṃ sa mthu dang shing tog rigs: zla rgyas dpal dang zla phrom 'byor: khur ba phrin las dngos grub sogs: thob bsam tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi yis: lus dkyil lha tshogs mchod par bya: de nas rnal 'byor pho mo rnams: nang dang gsang ba'i tshogs la rol: nyams bskyang glu gar rgyud 'chad nyan: drug pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni: phud lhag bsres shing sman raka sbreng: kha phru btab cing byin gyis brlab: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rang rtsal rig pa'i cho 'phrul gyi: bka' yi pho nya lhag sdud rnams: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam bcas ltar: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod: u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: gnyis pa gtor ma skyong ba ni: dang po chad mdo bsgrags pa ni: hūm̐: dus bzhi'i bde gshegs rig 'dzin thams cad kyi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam can srung ma'i tshogs: sngon tshe ji ltar zhal bzhes ma g.yel bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan srung phrin las myur du sgrub pa dang:

bar chad dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog par mdzod: gnyis pa bshal chus brtan skyong ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: bka' dang dam la bzhag pa yi: brtan ma chen po khyod rnams kyis: bshal chu bdud rtsi 'di gsol la: rnal 'byor bdag gi sdong grogs dang: zab gter bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: pad+ma dhā ki nī bh+yo ba liṃ ta a mṛta khā hi: gsum pa rjes sdud bro brdung niḥ hūm̐: mnyam nyid klong yangs chen po 'dir: bde chen rang rtsal dbang gi bro: rta skad 'tsher zhing hūm̐ phaṭa sgrog: ma rig bdud bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs: bdag med ka dag dbyings su mnan: oṃ laṃ hūṃ laṃ: s+t+wam+bha ya nan: bzhi pa dngos grub skul ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes thugs mchog bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du: mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam la gnas byas te: bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi mtha' ru phyin dus 'dir: rje btsun chen po ma hā gu ru yi: sku gsung thugs kyi mchog gi dngos grub dang: 'chi med tshe dang rigs rgyud 'gro don sogs: thun mong dngos grub myur ba nyid du stsol: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: lnga pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: dkyil 'khor thams cad gtso la 'dus: bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' nyid: dgyes pa chen pos rang la thim: rang yang kun gzhi ma bcos pa'i: ngang la ye nas 'dzin pa bral: rnam dag spros bral chos kyi sku ra: mnyam par bzhag la rtag mtha' bsal: de nas chad mtha' bsal ba ni: slar yang bdag nyid dbang gi sku: gnas gsum 'bru gsum rdo rje'i go: spyi bor rig 'dzin bla ma bcas: snang srid lha sngags ye shes che: oṃ badz+ra kā bā tsita āḥhūm̐: drug pa smon lam bkra shis ni: bdag gis bla ma bsgrubs pa yi: bsod nams 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams: bar chad kun zhi mthun rkyen 'byor: sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas: ye shes bla ma'i sa thob shog: byin rlabs rtsa ba dkyil 'khor gtso:

bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog: dngos grub kun bdag zhi dang khro: yi dam rnams kyi bkra shis shog: phrin las kun sgrub bde chen dbyings: mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog: legs nyes stangs 'dzin bar chad sel: chos srung rnams kyi bkra shis shog: sa lam 'bras bu dus gcig rdzogs: rdo rje theg pa'i bkra shis shog: bdun pa rgyun gyi spyod lam ni: snang ba thams cad lha ru gsal: grags pa thams cad sngags kyi gdangs: gang shar ma bcos ye grol dang: dag snang mos gus nges 'byung bskyed: bza' btung tshogs kyi 'khor lor bsam: 'gro 'dug sgrib sbyong bskor ba dang: spyod lam 'gro ba'i don du spyod: de dag rjes kyi las rim mo: de ltar bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs: yang zab snying por don 'dril ba: nyams su sus blangs dngos grub thob: da lta ye shes mtsho rgyal dang: me tog sgron la sogs pa yi: skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su longs: phyi rabs don du gter du sbos: da lta'i las 'phro dbang btsan nas: ma 'ongs dus su 'tshogs nas su: 'gro la phan pa'i don du 'gyur: ces gsungs pa ltar kho mo mtsho rgyal gyis yi ger btab ste gter du sbas pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sbrul lo smin drug zla ba'i nyer lnga la 'bum rdzong gsang ba'i brag phug nas/ mchog gyur gling pas thabs shes rten 'brel 'dzom pa'i skabs/ mkhan chen zla sprul rin po che dang*/ zur mang bstan 'dzin mchog sprul sogs las can chos bdag du mas mthong bar spyan drangs/ lo gsum gsang rgyas btab ste/ slar yang chos 'di'i bdag po bde chen chos sgron gyis bskul ba phyi nang gi rten 'brel 'dzom nas 'og min karmar phab pa'i yi ge pa ni pradz+nyā dhā dza'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// //
